segments.name: Automotive Marketplace
segments.description: Operates the Cars.com automotive marketplace plus dealer websites, media solutions and trade and appraisal tools for dealers, OEMs and consumers.

revenueModel.text: Dealers and OEMs pay subscription fees for marketplace listings and packages, dealer websites, media solutions and trade and appraisal tools.
revenueModel.evidence: We generate approximately 80% of our revenue via subscription-based solutions, creating a dependable recurring revenue stream across our diversified mix of marketplace subscription advertising packages, digital solutions, and media.
